17857581o753k1.content:
NewswireRockstar GamesAnnouncements
Introducing nopixel V
See the Next Evolution of the GTAV Roleplay Community
September 1, 2026

For years, we’ve seen the exciting possibilities and passion that the creator community brings to expand upon the worlds of Grand Theft Auto V and Red Dead Redemption 2. GTAV Roleplay is one prominent example of how creators have brought their signature blend of creativity to these experiences and have pioneered new ways to play and watch our games.

Today, we are proud to support nopixel — who have continually pushed the boundaries of GTA Roleplay through character immersion, modifications to the GTAV map, and a creative community of dedicated storytellers — with the official announcement of the nopixel V closed beta arriving on September 8 where invited players will access the experience through the Rockstar Games Launcher. 

Check out nopixel’s trailer now on their YouTube channel and tune in across livestreaming platforms from September 8 to watch the nopixel community kick off its latest adventures across Los Santos — with some familiar faces reprising fan-favorite characters and new personalities beginning their own stories.

GTA Roleplay transforms Grand Theft Auto V into a community-run, multiplayer version of Los Santos where players create their own characters and tell their own stories in a dynamic, shared world. From civilians pursuing an honest living to criminals chasing their next score — and the player-run police force keeping them in check — every player helps shape the city, and every relationship matters. 

For years, nopixel has set the standard for the genre through its ambitious releases. Now, nopixel V overhauls the experience once more: A reworked character customization system gives roleplayers more ways than ever to create characters as unique as their backstories, while new corners of the city — from the brand new Pixel Hotel & Casino to a six-block revamp of Cypress Flats — set the stage for new stories. 

With refreshed visuals, new ways to make a living on either side of the law, and smarter, more reactive pedestrians, GTA Roleplay has never felt more alive, and there has never been a better time to tune in. 

Claim the Burger Shot Tracksuit and GTA$1,500,000 with Twitch Drops

Watch your favorite GTA Roleplay streamers play nopixel V on Twitch to earn up to GTA$1,500,000 and the Burger Shot Tracksuit in GTA Online from September 8–30 with Twitch Drops. 


And More… 

Keep an eye out for more news about future updates, including improvements like a new PC in-game overlay, upcoming events, and expanded access to nopixel V’s world of GTA Roleplay.
17857581o753k1.title: Introducing nopixel V

Exporting Mixed Goods will dish out Double Rewards, and stockpiling Special Cargo is easy with doubled Staff Sourcing speeds. Meanwhile, compromising targets to a permanent end on behalf of crime lord Martin Madrazo in Madrazo Hits will earn you 2X GTA$ and RP.

Inject a couple hundred CCs of road rage directly into the black market as a Biker from September 10–16 and score Double Rewards on a variety of illicit activities.

Offload surplus weaponry in the Ammu-Nation Contract by hopping in your Bunker’s parked Duneloader for Double Rewards this week, along with 2X GTA$ and RP for securely transporting high-value goods from the Bobcat Security and Gruppe Sechs depots in Safeguard Deliveries.

You can also take advantage of a number of vehicle discounts, including 70% off the Pfister Astron Custom (SUV) at Legendary Motorsport on PS5, XBOX Series X|S, and PC (Enhanced).

September 24–30: Nightclub Bonuses

Keep your Nightclub on everyone’s Snapmatic feed with 2X Popularity for completing Nightclub Management Missions. Stock the subterranean shelves of your Nightclub Warehouse by helping Yohan out in Nightclub Goods Missions, awarding 2X GTA$ and RP from September 24–30. 

Breaking into the Los Santos nightlife scene for the first time? Acquire the Elysian Island Nightclub free from Maze Bank Foreclosures this week to get started. If you’d rather move legalized scheduled substances and medical supplies, work as a courier completing QuickiePharm Deliveries to earn 2X GTA$ and RP. 

Make the most of vehicle discounts during the final week of this event, including 70% off the Imponte Arbiter GT (Muscle) that’s available from Southern San Andreas Super Autos on PS5, XBOX Series X|S, and PC (Enhanced).

GTA+ Members can still claim a free Gallivanter Warden (SUV) from the showroom inside The Vinewood Car Club through September 9. Members also get free Chameleon Paints, as well as Princess Robot Bubblegum apparel added automatically to their wardrobes. 

Look for details on the next round of special GTA+ Member benefits to hit the Newswire on September 10.

Soon to be broadcasting live across Leonida: the latest selection of the Grand Theft Auto series’ most distinct musical element, in-game radio stations.

Spanning stations dedicated to everything from Classic Rock to Talk Radio, Grand Theft Auto VI players will experience the biggest and widest-ranging selection of in-game radio yet.

Plus, for the first time ever, Grand Theft Auto VI introduces a series of on-demand podcasts for Jason and Lucia to experience beyond Leonida’s terrestrial radio, with both radio and podcasts available to listen to in vehicles and on foot through newly introduced headphones and earbuds connected to their smartphones.

Here’s a look at six of the stations featured in Grand Theft Auto VI: 

Cocoteo FM: Cocoteo FM is Leonida's home for the best of modern Latin music. Hosted by El Martillo and La Gata and featuring everything from bachata and merengue to dembow and reggaeton — Cocoteo FM is el party que nunca se apaga. 

Back Country Radio: MW and Delta Dawne blast renegade country music to the Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, and beyond. Stay tuned for Back Country’s roving reporter, swamp meteorologist, and Delta’s not-so-secret lover Mud Dog Mike checking in from the driver’s seat of his Grassrivers airboat. 

AfroBank FM: Turn up the gbedu with Burna and Palmsy, AfroBank FM's dynamic duo curating the best in African music, from 20th-century classics and undiscovered gems to contemporary sounds like amapiano, 3-step, and more. 

The Chamber 106.6: Crushing metal has landed in Leonida. Jump in the pit with DJ Kerry and DJ Tom for decades of timeless metal anthems as they channel Leonida’s deep metal roots.

Flash FM: The Vice City institution that delivers the best in pop music with Robyn and Alex — guaranteed to make you dance no matter where you find yourself in the Goodtime State. 

Dirty South Classics: A little southern hospitality from Trick and Trina, blasting regional rap and hip-hop classics. From the beach to the block, nobody reps Leonida and the South like they do. 

Listen to previews of these six stations at the Music section of the official site and stay tuned for more info to come, including details about Grand Theft Auto VI's dynamic score and more singles from Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album.  

You can also pre-save Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album, featuring 34 original tracks across a genre-defying roster of artists, or pre-order on vinyl and CD at gtavi-thealbum.com.

89834o94713o21.content:
NewswireGrand Theft Auto VIAnnouncements
Pre-Load Grand Theft Auto VI Now
November 10, 2026

Pre-loading is now available for everyone who has pre-ordered Grand Theft Auto VI digitally. Players who pre-ordered the code-in-box version can also activate their code and begin pre-loading as soon as it’s received. If you still have yet to pre-order, now’s the time to make sure you're prepared for November 19. 

Grand Theft Auto VI has been fully developed from the ground up to provide the best possible experience for the current generation of consoles, targeting 30 frames per second while pushing both platforms to their absolute limits to bring the vast and rich world of Leonida to life — while maintaining the density and visual fidelity of all its environments and inhabitants. 

The PlayStation 5 Pro offers breathtaking visuals, with improved clarity through PlayStation Spectral Super Resolution (PSSR) and ray-traced shadows only available on PlayStation 5 Pro. 

Grand Theft Auto VI for PS5 includes high-fidelity haptic feedback fully integrated across the game on DualSense controllers and adjustable via accessibility settings, improved spatial audio rendering so all in-game sounds take full advantage of Tempest 3D Audio, and improved load times, making Grand Theft Auto VI play best on PlayStation 5 consoles. 

The game will also be available via XBOX Cloud Gaming on XBOX Series X|S and XBOX One consoles, utilizing XBOX Series S graphics settings. And as with all cloud streaming, connection speeds and other technical factors may influence game performance in ways that would not impact local gameplay. GTAVI will also fully support Remote Play on PlayStation and XBOX. 

Check out today’s new video, featuring "Blood in Your Eyes" by Tove Lo from Grand Theft Auto VI: The Album. And for more information about Grand Theft Auto VI, including links to pre-order, check out the official site. 

We want to thank everyone in the community for your incredible support, and we can’t wait to see you all in Leonida on November 19.
89834o94713o21.title: Pre-Load Grand Theft Auto VI Now
